title: Sidebar 04
description: A documentation sidebar with nested navigation sections and a breadcrumb header.
deviations: shadcn source renders <Sidebar variant="floating"> for a padded, rounded, shadowed card look; our ui/sidebar/sidebar.marko has no `variant` prop (only open/class/content), so this block renders as a flush, bordered sidebar instead. Kit gap: sidebar.marko needs a variant prop (floating/inset) to reach parity.

shadcn source uses SidebarMenuSub/SidebarMenuSubItem/SidebarMenuSubButton for the nested nav items; our ui/sidebar kit has no menu-sub* primitives. This block falls back to a plain <ul>/<li> wrapper and reuses SidebarMenuButton (smaller size, via class override) for the sub-links so active/hover/focus styling stays sourced from the design system. Kit gap: a SidebarMenuSub family should be built.
